declared_by: drafted by a coding agent (Claude Code) before any sensitivity result was computed; not revised after seeing results
base_population: human experiments with exactly one increased and one decreased profile (load_profiles, paired, human, blank counts rejected)
study_weighting: mean of eligible experiment contrasts within study; each eligible study weighted equally
test: two-sided exact binomial test of non-tied studies shifting up against 0.5, with an exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval for that share
min_studies_note: a scenario row with fewer eligible studies is reported descriptively with status insufficient_support and no p or q

scenarios.population: all complete pairs; a zero-total profile scores fraction 0 (the historical rule)
scenarios.family: BH over the six Table 1 traits
scenarios.purpose: reproduce the published six-trait directions exactly

scenarios.population: complete pairs with a positive non-MediaDive total on both sides (shared comparison basis)
scenarios.family: BH over the six Table 1 traits

scenarios.population: per ratio, pairs with all four named counts positive
scenarios.purpose: the existing complete-case analysis, retained as one labelled scenario

scenarios.population: per ratio, the numerator's and the reference's fractions on exactly that ratio's S2 pairs
scenarios.family: BY over the 30 matched fraction rows
scenarios.purpose: separate population change (S1 vs S3) from estimand change (S3 vs S2)

scenarios.population: pairs with all six traits positive on both sides
scenarios.family: BH over the six fractions; BY over the 15 ratios
scenarios.purpose: one population for every reference, so ratio orderings can be compared

scenarios.population: for each of the 20 trait triples, pairs with all three traits positive on both sides; A/B, B/C and A/C on that set
scenarios.purpose: reference consistency within a triple on a shared population

scenarios.population: S2 restricted to the exact body-site label Feces
S2 restricted to every exact body-site label other than Feces
S2 with each eligible study removed in turn
scenarios.family: BY over the 15 ratios, the other 14 p-values held at their S2 values
scenarios.purpose: influence: share and p ranges, and the studies whose removal moves BY q across 0.05

decision_threshold_for_reporting: q <= 0.05 is used only to count which rows would change status; no preferred scenario or cutoff is selected
not_done: no scenario is chosen by its q-value
no claim of absolute abundance, independent replication, or generalisation to excluded studies
